project_type: Flutter mobile apps (user + admin) with Supabase backend
build_system: Flutter CLI with dart-define for secrets, CI via GitHub Actions
test_command: No tests exist - validation is flutter analyze
verification_instructions: Run flutter analyze in both root and admin_app directories. Both must pass without errors (warnings allowed).
setup_instructions: No setup needed - network blocked, cannot run pub get. CI handles dependencies.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages, cannot run pub get, cannot run flutter build locally. All validation must be AST/syntax-level. CI on GitHub handles actual builds. Commit and push changes for CI to validate.
contribution_requirements: Push to Rexo-Kotlin branch. Both flutter-build.yml (user app) and flutter-admin-build.yml (admin app) must pass.
key_patterns: Riverpod StateNotifier pattern for state. go_router for navigation. SharedPreferences for local settings. Supabase for backend. AppColors for theming (currently hardcoded light colors in many screens). PremiumCard widget in admin. ConsumerWidget/ConsumerStatefulWidget throughout.
directory_structure: Root: Flutter user app (lib/, android/, assets/). admin_app/: separate Flutter admin app. Both share Supabase backend. assets/logo.png is 512x512 RGBA. mipmap icons exist at all densities (mdpi through xxxhdpi) for both apps.
